name: 23932-manyimage-minicpmv8b-1gpu
model: openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4_5 — ungated and public, 17.39 GB of safetensors, served with --trust-remote-code.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 — one in-process vLLM engine; an 8.7B bf16 model fits one card with room for KV.
architecture: MiniCPM-V 4.5 multimodal decoder, ~8.7B params bf16: an 8B-class language tower (36 layers, hidden 4096, 32 heads over 8 KV heads) behind a vision tower and a 64-query resampler; slice_mode on, max_slice_nums 9, scale_resolution 448.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup 13.05% in `mode: requests` (= 128 requests, exactly one full wave), no cooldown, bounded at 985 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: single-turn high-resolution image chat: one distinct 1920x1080 JPEG and one distinct ~97-token prompt per request, 117 output tokens. Two guidellm datasets zipped row-wise — `synthetic_text` for prompt and output length, `synthetic_image` for the image.
purpose: A high-resolution photo question-answering assistant on one GPU, serving 128 concurrent users short single-turn image prompts.
launch:
model: openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4_5
trust-remote-code: true
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
max-model-len: 8192
